publicationRepairEvidence.productionControl: partition invalid fields into isolated packets of at most two fields; one attempt per packet; no recursive automatic retry

computeProjection.basis: stage-batched wall-clock planning estimate, not aggregate serial model time
uncertainties: ChatGPT subscription throughput and rate limits may vary.
The repair-incidence estimate comes from five deliberately difficult debates.
Paid transcription fallback frequency across the full corpus is not yet observed in production.
The estimate assumes the tested stage concurrency and excludes human review time.

decision.qualityAssessment: The workflow is sufficiently rigorous and internally controlled for an AI-only staged production run. Source fidelity, pass isolation, deterministic dispute extraction, audio escalation, adjudication-before-scoring, score stability, publication integrity, and responsive rendering have each passed on the five hard-route debates.
decision.limitations: The result remains an AI adjudicated consensus rather than ground truth. The 94% dispute rate makes adjudication a core stage, and the 40% publication-repair incidence requires a bounded field-only repair lane.
